shortDescription: This module implements SSH Client which helps to run svcinfo CLI command on IBM Spectrum Virtualize family storage systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: command
options.description: Single svcinfo CLI command to be executed on Spectrum Virtualize storage system. Each command must start with svcinfo keyword.

options.name: key_filename
options.description: SSH client private key filename. By default, C(~/.ssh/id_rsa) is used.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for the Spectrum Virtualize storage system.

options.name: usesshkey
options.description: For key-pair based SSH connection, set this field as C('yes'). Provide full path of keyfile in key_filename field. If not provided, default path of SSH key is used.
